summary: Frontend-only validation of the refactored FreshnessBadge (MIN-of-critical-sources / worst-case). All acceptance criteria PASS. Login admin@pdpv.pt/HCNMEnKMLq succeeds, /finance renders with data-testid='finance-freshness-badge'. Badge text 'Atualizado há 11h' with emerald semantic classes (bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-300) since the OLDEST critical source (open_documents @ 02/07/2026 00:03:12) is <12h old. Tooltip 'title' attribute contains: level label 'Estado das fontes críticas (dados frescos):', line 'Saldos Vencidos: 02/07/2026, 00:03:35', line 'Documentos Aberto: 02/07/2026, 00:03:12', and EXCLUDES non-critical sources (Info Clientes / Evolução de Crédito) — exactly as specified. Code review of lines 82-118 confirms the reduce picks MIN via strict '<' comparison across CRITICAL_SOURCES=['overdue_balances','open_documents']. No regressions detected on the dashboard KPIs (Total Vencido 23 670,06€, aging buckets, top devedores, Estado dos Dados card, sidebar Finance group).
critical_code_review_comments: The MIN-of-critical logic (lines 89-93) uses reduce with strict '<' — this correctly returns the oldest item and is stable when timestamps tie (keeps the first-encountered). Good.

The tooltip currently only shows the two CRITICAL sources. That is intentional and correct per the new spec, but a user might still want to see non-critical source dates. Consider a secondary 'Estado dos Dados' card link inside the tooltip or an aria-describedby — non-blocking.

The 'nunca importado' path (both critical sources missing last_import_at) could not be exercised at runtime because seed data currently has both critical timestamps populated. Verified in code (lines 89-96): critical=[] → oldest=null → oldestDate=null → getFreshnessLevel(null) returns bg-red-100 red with label 'sem dados' and relative='nunca importado'. Logic is correct by inspection.

Minor a11y: title attribute is used for the tooltip. Screen readers do not consistently announce native title tooltips. Consider migrating to a Radix/shadcn Tooltip with aria-describedby when accessibility becomes a priority. Non-blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (7/7 acceptance criteria validated; 1 not runtime-exercisable — 'nunca importado' — validated via code inspection)

test_credentials: admin@pdpv.pt / HCNMEnKMLq (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md) — worked, 200 login, JWT issued, /finance accessible.
context_for_next_testing_agent: FreshnessBadge on /finance now uses MIN(last_import_at) restricted to CRITICAL_SOURCES=['overdue_balances','open_documents']. Test seed on preview currently has overdue_balances=02/07/2026 00:03:35 and open_documents=02/07/2026 00:03:12, so open_documents is the oldest critical and drives the badge (~11h, emerald). To exercise the 'nunca importado' red path, a future iteration would need to clear last_import_at on BOTH critical sources in the DB (or a test fixture endpoint). To exercise yellow/orange/red-time levels, use a DB fixture that back-dates open_documents to 12-24h / 24-48h / >48h. Non-critical sources (client_info, credit_evolution) are intentionally excluded from both the badge level and the tooltip lines.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bug. iteration_25 code-review recommendation (MAX→MIN of critical sources) was correctly applied by E1 and verified end-to-end in the browser.
